rationale: Builds directly on the current best quantization path instead of revisiting broader recurrence ideas. The closest recent miss showed late tail `mlp.fc` EMA was almost helpful, and an earlier close miss suggested transposed `mlp.fc` weights are sensitive to mild clipping. This variant keeps the winning columnwise/transposed MLP setup, adds a gentler transpose-only int8 clip default (`99.98`) for `mlp.fc.weight`, and extends the existing late projection EMA to only the last two tail `mlp.fc` weights so the most quantization-sensitive expansion matrices are smoothed without broadening EMA coverage across the whole stack. The change is size-neutral at the model level, compile-stable, and targets the exact final int8+zlib roundtrip metric.
title: Transpose-Clip Tail-FC EMA Blend
